rationale: The workflow runs a 4-cell matrix with fail-fast explicitly set to false, which is the exact before-state of the P-LIT-FAIL-FAST pattern (cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure). The pattern is reviewed with estimated benefit (matrix cancellation saves remaining work), and the matching synthetic experiment examples (batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242, batch-scenario-three-run-b6e04fef7ef24997) report scenario_passed when switching fail-fast from false to true. The change is a single strategy flip: fail-fast: true. It preserves all build/test steps, the matrix, required-check behavior (the workflow still fails when any cell fails), permissions, actions, and secrets; it only stops launching additional matrix cells once a failure has occurred, saving CI resources on already-failed runs. No new network access, privileged actions, or publishing/deployment operations are added.
